fields.summary_ko.0: Philippe Laffont of Coatue Management opened a new position in SK hynix (SKHY) in Q3, as institutional capital rotation toward memory chip manufacturers accelerates due to growing high-bandwidth memory demand.
fields.summary_ko.1: SK hynix recorded Q3 revenue of KRW 104.62 trillion (up 328% year-over-year), operating profit of KRW 83.33 trillion (up over 7-fold), and net income of KRW 39.78 trillion, with gross margin reaching 86%.
